about_the_game:
You finally made it!

Here you will find the original soundtrack for Adventures of Deliveryman

This album was written by Aleksandr Gurjev (except track 14 which is a collab with Bobek) under various aliases. No live or digital instruments were harmed thru that process.

Race at full speed or leisurely pedal through the city streets – tracks in genres like idm, jungle, house and more will guide you every step of the way.

This soundtrack is released in support of our game. Purchasing it will directly support our humble indie development efforts.
